nodes.title: SG-4.2 · Serve the current round at /round/current
nodes.body:
Context: backend/internal/server/server.go:46 registers GET /api/v1/worlds/{id}/rounds/current, but the spec path is /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current. Desired behavior: the server serves the current round at the spec path and a routing test uses that path. Expected result: the specified path returns the current round and the old plural path is no longer routed. Why: API consumers must match the documented contract.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a world and a round on disk, when GET /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/round/current is requested, then the response is 200 with the round JSON
- Given the same data, when GET /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/rounds/current is requested, then the response is 404
- A routing test in the server package requests the specified path


## Scope
- In scope: Change the route path in backend/internal/server/server.go
- In scope: Add a routing test using the specified path
- Out of scope: Changing the CurrentRound handler or repository logic
- Out of scope: Other routes
- Preserve: world.Handler.CurrentRound behavior and 404 handling
- Preserve: All other registered routes


## Technical constraints
- Go with Chi router; no database


## Definition of done
- Route is /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current
- Server routing test passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Current round is routed at GET /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current
nodes.body:
Context: server.go registers wh.CurrentRound at /rounds/current. Desired behavior: register it at /round/current and drop the plural path. Expected result: the specified path serves the current round JSON. Why: it matches the API contract.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given seeded world and round files, when GET /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/round/current is requested, then status is 200 and the JSON round id is round-0000001
- When GET /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/rounds/current is requested, then status is 404
- When GET /api/v1/worlds/unknown/round/current is requested, then status is 404


## Scope
- In scope: server.go route registration
- Out of scope: Handler or repo changes
- Preserve: Other world routes


## Technical constraints
- Keep using wh.CurrentRound


## Definition of done
- Only the singular path is registered for the current round


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Verify: Current round route unit tests
nodes.body:
Add a server routing test that seeds a temp repo with a world and a round and asserts the singular path serves 200, the plural path 404, and an unknown world 404.

## Acceptance criteria
- GET /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/round/current returns 200 with id round-0000001
- GET /rounds/current returns 404
- Unknown world returns 404


## Scope
- In scope: backend/internal/server/server_test.go
- Out of scope: Production code
- Preserve: Existing server tests


## Technical constraints
- Use t.TempDir and httptest only; no live ports


## Definition of done
- TestNew_CurrentRoundRoute passes


## Clarifying questions
- None
nodes.description: Add a server routing test that seeds a temp repo with a world and a round and asserts the singular path serves 200, the plural path 404, and an unknown world 404.
technical_constraints: Use t.TempDir and httptest only; no live ports

steps.action:
Add a test that builds cfg with Storage.RepoPath=t.TempDir(), writes worlds/the-boys-room/world.yaml (same content as the theBoysRoomYAML const in backend/internal/world/world_test.go) and rounds/round-0000001/round.yaml ('id: round-0000001
number: 1
status: open
starts_at: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z
ends_at: 2026-01-02T00:00:00Z
') with os.MkdirAll and os.WriteFile, calls New(cfg, discard logger), then subtests request via httptest: /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/round/current expects 200 and body containing round-0000001; /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/rounds/current expects 404; /api/v1/worlds/unknown/round/current expects 404. Add imports os and path/filepath.
steps.expected: All three subtests pass, proving the spec path is routed and the old path is not.
